title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Revelation 21: the new heaven and new earth, the holy city New Jerusalem, and its gates, walls and light.

questions.text: What did John see after the first heaven and the first earth had passed away?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:1 says he saw a new heaven and a new earth, and that the sea is no more.

answers.text: A new heaven and a new earth
A great white throne
An open door in heaven
A woman clothed with the sun

questions.text: The holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven was prepared like what?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:2 says the city was prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

answers.text: Like a garden full of trees
Like a camp of tents
Like a bride adorned for her husband
Like a king coming to war

questions.text: According to the loud voice out of heaven, what will be no more?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:4 says he will wipe away every tear, and that death will be no more, nor mourning, nor crying, nor pain.

answers.text: The day and the night
Death, mourning, crying and pain
Hunger and thirst for water
The kings and the nations

questions.text: What did he who sits on the throne say he was doing?
questions.explanation: He who sits on the throne said, "Behold, I am making all things new", and told John to write, for these words of God are faithful and true.

answers.text: Opening the books of judgment
Gathering the nations for war
Sealing up the prophecy
Making all things new

questions.text: From what will he give freely to the one who is thirsty?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:6 says he will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

answers.text: From the river of the nations
From the spring of the water of life
From the well of the holy city
From the cup of his wrath

questions.text: What names were written on the twelve gates of the city?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:12 says the city had twelve gates with twelve angels at them, and names written on them, the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

answers.text: The names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel
The names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb
The names of the seven assemblies
The names of the kings of the earth

questions.text: What was written on the twelve foundations of the city's wall?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:14 says the wall had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

answers.text: The names of the twelve months of the year
The words of the prophecy of this book
Twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb
A name which no one knows but he himself

questions.text: What were the twelve gates of the city made of?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:21 says the twelve gates were twelve pearls, each one of the gates made of one pearl, and the street of the city was pure gold.

answers.text: Jasper
Brass and iron
Cedar wood
Pearls

questions.text: What did John say he did not see in the city?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:22 says he saw no temple in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb, are its temple.

answers.text: A temple
A wall
A street
Twelve gates

questions.text: Who are the only ones who will enter the city?
questions.explanation: Revelation 21:27 says nothing profane and no one who causes an abomination or a lie will enter it, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.

answers.text: Only the twelve tribes of Israel
Those who measured its walls
Those who are written in the Lamb's book of life
The twelve angels at the gates
